reasons: Summary accurately reflects source description of Pinot as open-source, distributed, column-oriented OLAP data store with low-latency queries over streaming/batch sources
Mechanism 1 correctly describes pluggable indexing types (Sorted, Bitmap, Inverted, Star-Tree, Range) and broker-based query routing using segment-to-server routing table per source
Mechanism 2 correctly describes Apache Helix for cluster management with embedded agents and ZooKeeper coordination per source
Unknowns list appropriately identifies internal details not covered in source (data placement strategy, query pipeline details, compression parameters, ingestion guarantees)
No unsupported mechanisms, copied passages, or invented execution found
